- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.00) — reduce forecast peak values by 1–3% relative to model output.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment = 0.00) — add 1–3% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — if last 3–5 days show sharp upward movement, cap forecast peak at 1–2% below prior high.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in cycle — adjust downward by 1–2% for first 10 days if sentiment neutral or bearish.
- If sentiment history shows sudden shift from 0.00 to 0.25+ within 3 days, reduce forecast by 2–5% to avoid momentum overfitting.
